### 1. Discovery & Translational Science

* **Histological aging clocks developed from multi-tissue imaging and transcriptomics** [Nature Medicine](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04566-5)
  * Researchers utilized whole-slide histopathological images across 40 tissue types to map morphological aging signatures.
  * By pairing these structural changes with transcriptomic data from blood, the authors developed localized aging clocks to monitor tissue-specific integrity and organ-level physiological fitness in health and disease.

* **Nordic AI-Health Initiative platform launched for drug discovery** [Nature Medicine](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04575-4)
  * A new technical framework outlines the deployment of an AI-Health infrastructure platform utilizing large-scale longitudinal and multimodal health datasets from across the Nordic region.
  * The platform is designed to provide secure, regulation-compliant access to train generalizable models for clinical and drug discovery applications.

* **Preclinical and computational discovery research briefs** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42601067/) | [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42600762/) | [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42600746/) | [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42600661/) | [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42600493/)
  * *Oncology Targets*: A multi-omics profiling study characterized the action of OTSSP167, a MELK inhibitor, in adrenocortical carcinoma [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42601067/). Separately, dual-view oblique plane microscopy was applied to screen small-molecule compounds in 3D glioblastoma stem cell spheroids with single-cell resolution [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42600493/).
  * *Virology*: Fragment screening identified novel druggable binding pockets on the SARS-CoV-2 PLpro protease to guide structure-based inhibitor design [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42600661/). A universal cell-based method was developed for high-throughput screening of viroporin function and inhibition [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42600762/).
  * *In Silico Models*: Quantitative structure-activity relationship (QSAR) modeling was validated as an accelerator for identifying small molecules that catalyze corneal endothelial regeneration [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42600746/).
  * *Biomarkers*: Retrospective evaluation of patients from the JCOG0802/WJOG4607L clinical trial confirmed that the spread through airspaces (STAS) is a significant prognostic factor in Stage Ia/bN₀ non-small cell lung cancer [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42600842/).

---

### 2. Early Trials — Phase I–II

* **Durvalumab plus olaparib Phase II trial multi-omics identifies SCLC responder subgroup** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42601174/)
  * A multi-omics analysis of a Phase II trial evaluating durvalumab plus olaparib as maintenance therapy for small-cell lung cancer (SCLC) identified a clinical benefit subgroup.
  * The responders were characterized by distinct DNA hypomethylation signatures, offering a potential biomarker for future patient stratification.

* **Fetoscopic spina bifida repair trial demonstrates feasibility** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42600674/)
  * A nonrandomized clinical trial confirmed the surgical feasibility of performing fetoscopic spina bifida repairs using a human umbilical cord meningeal patch.

---

### 3. Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

* **Phase III NEAT trial evaluates dexamethasone in ataxia telangiectasia** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42600624/)
  * The multicentre, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase III NEAT trial evaluated the neurological effects of encapsulated dexamethasone sodium phosphate.
  * The study enrolled pediatric patients aged 6–9 years old diagnosed with ataxia telangiectasia.

* **ONCO PE trial evaluates rivaroxaban in low-risk pulmonary embolism** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42601051/)
  * The randomized ONCO PE trial investigated the use of extended anticoagulation therapy with rivaroxaban in patients with cancer-associated, low-risk pulmonary embolism.
  * The trial assessed clinical outcomes and safety profiles stratified by the presence of concomitant deep vein thrombosis (DVT).

---

### 4. Regulatory & Approvals

* **[Big Pharma]** **FDA grants accelerated approval to Zenbexus (iberdomide) for multiple myeloma** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/bristol-myers-zenbexus-fda-multiple-myeloma-celmod-celgene/827912/) | [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/14/fda-approves-bristol-multiple-myeloma-drug-zenbexus/)
  * The FDA granted accelerated approval to Bristol Myers Squibb’s Zenbexus (iberdomide) in combination with Johnson & Johnson's Darzalex (daratumumab) and dexamethasone for second-line multiple myeloma treatment.
  * Zenbexus is the first approved cereblon E3 ligase modulator (CELMoD), a novel class that leverages the cellular waste disposal system to degrade diseased cells.
  * The approval is based on Phase 3 trial data where 41% of patients on the Zenbexus combination achieved minimal residual disease (MRD)-negative status, compared to 21% of patients receiving a bortezomib-containing regimen. Progression-free survival data are expected in the coming months to support full approval.

* **[Biotech]** **Capricor shares surge as FDA agrees to review amended deramiocel filing** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/capricor-fda-cytokinetics-lawsuit-valneva-indupro-rusfertide-veppanu/827770/) | [X / @BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2088207637892464936)
  * Capricor Therapeutics announced the FDA's willingness to review an amended BLA for its Duchenne muscular dystrophy cell therapy, deramiocel.
  * The company will submit new follow-up data to support a refined indication focused on upper limb function (which gained panel support despite a negative vote on the Duchenne cardiomyopathy indication), likely extending the current August 22, 2026 PDUFA date.
  * Following the announcement, Cantor Fitzgerald upgraded the stock to Overweight with a $28 price target.

* **[Biotech]** **EMA accepts Lyme disease vaccine application from Valneva and Pfizer** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/capricor-fda-cytokinetics-lawsuit-valneva-indupro-rusfertide-veppanu/827770/)
  * The European Medicines Agency (EMA) validated and accepted the submission for the Lyme disease vaccine candidate developed by Valneva in partnership with Pfizer.

* **[Biotech]** **Replimune prepares for U.S. launch of TUDRIQEV** [X / @BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2088235621005271404)
  * Replimune has initiated commercial launch preparations in the U.S. for TUDRIQEV (vusolimogene oderparepvec-wtpg), anticipating market availability within 60 days following its recent FDA approval in combination with nivolumab for advanced melanoma.

* **FDA updates withdrawn oncology accelerated approvals registry** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/resources-information-approved-drugs/withdrawn-cancer-accelerated-approvals)
  * The FDA updated its list of withdrawn indications, noting the official removals of Tazverik (tazemetostat) for epithelioid sarcoma and relapsed/refractory follicular lymphoma (withdrawn June 22, 2026), and Xpovio (selinexor) for relapsed/refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (withdrawn April 30, 2026).

* **FDA drafts new packaging guidance and schedules complex generic workshops** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/regulatory-information/search-fda-guidance-documents/container-closure-systems-human-drugs-and-biological-products) | [FDA (CRCG)](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/guidance-compliance-regulatory-information/center-research-complex-generics)
  * The FDA issued a draft guidance document, "Container Closure Systems for Human Drugs and Biological Products," establishing principles to evaluate packaging and combination product constituent parts.
  * The Center for Research on Complex Generics (CRCG), a joint venture between the FDA and the Universities of Maryland and Michigan, announced upcoming workshops: "Navigating the GLP-1 Generic Drug Pathway" (September 23–24, 2026) and "Advancing Bioequivalence Frameworks for Inhalation Drug Products" (October 14–15, 2026).
  * The FDA scheduled a public meeting for September 16, 2026, to discuss the recommendations for the reauthorization of the Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA) for fiscal years 2028 through 2032.

---

### 5. Business & Strategy

* **[Biotech]** **Cytokinetics sues Bristol Myers Squibb to defend Myqorzo patent space** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/capricor-fda-cytokinetics-lawsuit-valneva-indupro-rusfertide-veppanu/827770/)
  * Cytokinetics filed a lawsuit against BMS, claiming BMS obtained a patent covering hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) treatment methods despite having zero involvement in Myqorzo's discovery.
  * Cytokinetics argues the patent is a litigation tactic designed to slow down the launch and adoption of its heart drug Myqorzo (aficamten), which competes directly with BMS's Camzyos (mavacamten).

* **[Big Pharma]** **Novartis wins UK patent battle over heart failure therapy Entresto** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/14/biotech-news-pbms-agree-to-display-trumprx-drug-prices/)
  * Novartis secured a favorable ruling in a patent dispute in the United Kingdom defending its blockbuster heart failure drug Entresto (sacubitril/valsartan).

* **[Biotech]** **KKR pares down stake in BridgeBio with $390M offering** [X / @BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2088234386814570514)
  * KKR sold 5 million shares of BridgeBio ($BBIO) in a secondary offering priced at $78 per share, reducing its overall stake in the company from 7.3% to 4.7%.

* **[Biotech]** **Faron Pharmaceuticals initiated with Outperform rating at Leerink** [X / @BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2088210662467994086)
  * Leerink initiated coverage of Faron Pharmaceuticals ($FRNM) with an Outperform rating and an initial price target of $18.

* **Valisure sues U.S. Pharmacopeia over testing standard criticisms** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/08/14/controversial-lab-sues-usp-for-disparaging-its-testing-methods/)
  * Analytical laboratory Valisure filed a lawsuit against U.S. Pharmacopeia (USP), alleging that the standards organization made false and misleading statements about Valisure's testing methods for drug impurities.

* **Regional governments step up funding for biomanufacturing hubs** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/biotech-hub-race-investments-new-york-kansas-city-pennsylvania-central-virginia/827835/)
  * Pennsylvania launched the $125 million Innovate in PA 2.0 program to finance startups and build a statewide clinical trial network.
  * New York enacted a $65 million Bolstering Biotech Initiative in its fiscal 2027 budget to support performance-based commercialization grants and a clinical trial consortium.
  * Federal funding was also awarded to emerging hubs in Kansas City and the Richmond-Petersburg region of Central Virginia to support infrastructure and workforce development.

---

### 6. Public Health & Policy

* **FTC investigates Epic Systems over non-disclosure agreements and competition** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/14/epic-systems-ftc-review-nda-use-possible-anticompetitive-practices/)
  * Federal Trade Commission (FTC) investigators are conducting a broad inquiry into EHR giant Epic Systems to evaluate whether its business practices and extensive use of NDAs restrict competition.

* **Pharmacy benefit managers agree to list TrumpRx drug pricing** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/14/biotech-news-pbms-agree-to-display-trumprx-drug-prices/)
  * Major pharmacy benefit managers (PBMs) have agreed to display prices associated with the TrumpRx drug pricing framework.

* **CMS gender-affirming care rule faces legal assessment** [STAT](https://www.statnews.com/2026/08/14/cms-transgender-care-rule-how-will-legal-challenges-fare/)
  * A finalized rule from the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) protecting gender-affirming care is expected to face legal challenges, though experts note it may prove more legally resilient than previous rollbacks due to its regulatory framework.

* **FDA schedules public meeting to assess public health impact of opioids** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/news-events-human-drugs/addressing-public-health-effects-opioid-medications-09092026)
  * The FDA, in partnership with the Reagan-Udall Foundation, announced a hybrid public meeting on September 9, 2026, to discuss the conditions of use, safety profiles, and benefit-risk assessments of opioid medications for pain and addiction.

* **Studies analyze trial transparency and diversity in underrepresented populations** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42600890/) | [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42600922/)
  * *Ovarian Cancer*: An analysis of 3,720 ovarian cancer trials examined global geographic disparities, trial design characteristics, and data transparency [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42600890/).
  * *Native Communities*: A survey of American Indian and Alaska Native adults identified key motivating factors, beliefs, and attitudes that correlate with an increased willingness to participate in clinical trials [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42600922/).

* **Armed conflicts burden-of-disease modeling framework proposed** [Nature Medicine](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-026-04576-3)
  * A paper published in Nature Medicine proposes a framework for reconstructing missing or incomplete disease burden data in areas affected by active military conflicts.

---

**Worth watching**: The upcoming Phase 3 readout for Bristol Myers Squibb's Zenbexus measuring its impact on progression-free survival (PFS) and overall survival (OS) to support its transition to full FDA approval.
